Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Greta Kircher
Clan: Toreador antitribu (group 2)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: AUS CEL PRE obf
Sabbat: Once each action, if Greta is ready and you are being bled by
an ally or a younger vampire, Greta may burn a blood to reduce the
bleed amount by one.

Well the question is can she burn 2 blood to reduce 2 bleed. But only
burn blood once each action?

I know this question has been answered 100 times, but I couldn't find
it.

>>> Each bleed, she can burn a blood to reduce the bleed.
>>> "Once each action".

> My real quest was more like can she burn x blood to reduce x bleed.

If you mean "reduce X different bleed actions (one blood each)", then: yes, card
text.

If you mean "reduce one bleed action by X", then: no, card text.
